skillsbench-grading-protocol.name: skillsbench-grading-protocol
key_points: Do not copy oracle values from the test — the test may recompute ground truth from input files; produce the correct result independently
Anti-cheat tests verify behavioral consistency — outputs must match input data logically (physics, mode selection, etc.); fabricating results fails these checks

skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: NEVER rely on test.sh or bundled generation scripts running on host — the host verifier runs pytest directly; scripts like `gen_ground_truth.mjs`, `setup.sh`, or data preprocessors are NOT executed. Any file they produce must be pre-bake...
